Box is widely used in enterprise environments and offers strong administrative controls, compliance features, and large storage quotas.
Unlike path-based services (pCloud, WebDAV, S3), Box identifies every file and folder by a numeric ID. The Ensembles
bridges this gap by walking the folder hierarchy to resolve paths to Box IDs, caching the mappings to minimize API calls.

Each resolved ID is cached in an internal dictionary. Subsequent operations on the same path skip the API calls. The cache is invalidated when items are deleted or when not-found errors suggest staleness.
Folder listings are paginated automatically (up to 1000 items per page) to handle large directories.
